output.summary: Perennial flowering herbs and shrubs native to tropical regions of the Americas, lantanas bear aromatic clusters mixing red, orange, yellow, blue or white flowers. Individual flowers typically change colour as they mature, making a cluster appear two- or three-coloured.
output.edibilityNote: Reports conflict on whether ripe berries are edible; green berries are described as poisonous, while another source calls all lantana berries toxic to humans.
